components.name: InsightRail

upstream.name: beUI Timeline
upstream.licenceNote: Source named in the file header; mechanics adapted, no upstream asset or demo content copied.

kept: controlled value + onValueChange identity
measured stage width and derived card geometry
single track motion value driving per-item transform
neighbour scale plus a dimming veil
gap tick ruler between items
release spring (120 / 24 / 1) as the starting point
drag threshold, rubber band at the ends, flick projection
pointer capture for dragging, horizontal wheel support
one tab stop with arrow-key movement
changed: media cards, years and cables removed: this is a condensed rail of editions
neighbour scale 0.92 instead of the upstream 0.72, so a 13px title stays readable
geometry measured from the rail stage, not a full-height demo container
announcements fire once after settling, not per drag pixel
rejected: a second identity system for editions
scaling the whole stage horizontally offscreen on change

components.name: KnowledgeDealer

upstream.name: beUI Card Dealer
upstream.licenceNote: Source named in the file header; structure adapted, playing-card demo not copied.

kept: stable card ids across deck / hand / pile zones
measured stage and absolute card frames
imperative arc flight with a spring settle, cancelled per new move
stagger capped by a window so a three-card deal does not queue
3D face / back flip on the same element
depth-ordered z-index, hover and focus lift, neighbour push
reduced-motion path that places cards immediately
keyboard access without waiting for choreography
changed: pile replaced by an inline reader below the tray; cards return to the deck on collect
knowledge card sizes: clamp(tray * 0.36, 100, 150) x 1.32, fan step 0.78 of card width
face reserves the covered trailing strip (faceInset) so a fan never slices a word
narrow trays (<300px) become a one-card slot with backing edges and explicit previous/next card controls
the whole-card overlay button carries only the accessible name; all links live in the reader
the dashed landing area is shown only while the hand is empty
rejected: a text swap inside one stationary card
a decorative back plate pretending to be a deck
nested controls inside the card overlay button
infinite fake variety when the deck is exhausted
